name: New Darkhaven
check: 14 rooms the TinTin map files under New Darkhaven that no exit of the area reaches: Before the Face of Innocence and the chambers behind it (12845, 19694-19704), Mysteries Within to End of the Rim (15802-15805), Kinship of the Guilds (16338). Links to the TinTin map's 'visual' wall rooms (DH Wall) are left out.
the players' map's deathtrap south of Thieves Alley, and The Great Ship Meridia by the marina (no exit for them).
Park Avenue east of the Auction House, the Public Park, Tagerte's Conveyances, the Racial Skills Section of the library and the second 'In the Air' room: placed next to their neighbours.
